description: Get the hotels the user has saved as favorites in Gondola, newest first. Use this when the user asks about their favorite or saved hotels, or to ground recommendations in places they already like. Returns each hotel's name, hotel_id, chain, address, and the date it was saved. Pass the returned hotel_id to get_hotel_details or get_hotel_rates. When more favorites exist, the result includes a cursor; pass it back to fetch the next page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous get_favorite_hotels result, used to fetch the next page.

name: get_favorite_hotels
